same_map: The finite nonproper-image set permits one M dominating every parametrization. The triangular target change sends every infinity to e2; one B sends e2 to q with P_top(q) nonzero. Thus the same H has stable degree d>N and q regular fixed, without a choice depending on an iterate or on a later nonproper set.
finite_moments: FRAME finite-incarnation weights represent each normalized nef Cartier pullback globally under refinement. The constant global Jacobian gives the exhaustive coefficients a_E=-2r over target infinity, a_E=r over affine curves, while contracted primes pair zero. Hence the displayed A+ and A- integrals are finite nonnegative sums and W_n is the actual degree-weighted deficit cycle, including residual degrees and coalesced components.
limit: A8 plus FRAME uniqueness gives weak-* convergence through compactness/cluster subnets. Since A+ is nonnegative lower semicontinuous, Portmanteau has the required direction M<=liminf integral(A+)<=W/(d-N). No signed unbounded moment or continuity claim is used.
fixed_atoms: A single resolution retaining all omitted E_i suffices: H maps E_i to D_i and all later iterates are regular on the complete D_i, including q; the neighbourhood may depend on n. Refinement exceptional primes have zero pullback pairing. The resulting lower atoms have weights k_i=b_i*delta_i*deg(D_i)/d and A_i=r_i/b_i, preserving every delta_i.
equality: THIN gives (1-N/d)M=integral_K A dmu. The fixed atoms supply W/d, while the Portmanteau bound supplies the matching upper value. Equality follows. Subtracting the finite atomic lower measure leaves a positive measure on K with zero A-moment; the uniform A>=epsilon_H>0 forces that residual measure to vanish, so the killed restriction is exact.
carrier: For tau=A+mu, finiteness removes A=infinity mass and avoids 0*infinity. The live thinness identity and weighted Radon law give Hbullet_*(tau|live)=(N/d)tau for bounded Borel tests, extended monotonically. Survivor masses are (N/d)^n M and tend to zero. Exit mass lies on finitely many killed divisors; finite extensions have finitely many divisorial prolongations, so positive-A mass has a countable divisorial backward-orbit carrier.
foundations: Conditional on named FRAME/RZ-L2/A8, weak-tree thinness/lower-semicontinuity, finite boundary duality, resolution, all-Keller/composition, and finite valuation-extension foundations. Selected FJ statements were inspected; their cited proofs remain unaudited.
excluded: The original Betti upper-bound consumer still fails. No assertion of whole-measure atomicity, absence of A0 infinitely singular atoms or diffuse mass, Ctheta=0, W=0, zero boundary defect, Cartierness, valuativity, properness, N=1 or JC2.
